prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Ethiopian, in her mid 40s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in curly, real pores, real living eyes, 150 clicker rings piercings set with amethysts in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing a single piece of rose-gold earrings. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 25% of the way down her figure from the top, about 50% of the way down her figure from the top and about 79% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward, her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.
